data.gender_notes: Tajmul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Tajmul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Taj' which means crown or adornment. The suffix 'mul' denotes victory. This name is often given to a baby boy who is believed to be a victor, a conqueror, or someone who will be adorned with success and prosperity throughout his life. The name Tajmul carries the meaning “Crown, adornment, victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Tajmul usually hope their child will grow to embody crown, adornment, victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name is also associated with the divine energies of the Universe, and is believed to bestow upon the bearer the blessings of the gods.
